info.title: E# (Amiga E#) command line
info.description: The esharp command: compiles a restricted subset of C# to C and builds it into native Amiga programs (68020+ AmigaOS 3.1, AmigaOS 4 and MorphOS PowerPC, AROS) or an SDL 3 desktop build; runs them in FS-UAE, and runs the same source on the PC as a test host.

options.name: --target
options.description: m68k (default), os4, morphos, aros or sdl (desktop, SDL 3)

options.name: -o
options.description: Output directory (default: obj next to the sources)

options.name: --emit-only
options.description: Stop after writing the C file

options.name: --docker
options.description: Run the C compiler inside the toolchain image (default: esharp-amiga-toolchain; esharp-sdl for sdl)

options.name: --cc
options.description: Override the target's C compiler

options.name: --cflags
options.description: Override the target's C compiler flags

options.name: --allow-float
options.description: Permit float/double

options.name: --debug
options.description: Define DEBUG: bounds-checked arrays and spans, poisoned arena Reset (also defines TRACE)

options.name: --trace
options.description:
Define TRACE: keep Trace.Write/Line/Value calls (serial output); without it they compile to nothing
Run options (build options also apply; run is m68k, os4 or sdl):

options.name: --headless
options.description:
No window: run on a virtual display, print the program's output, exit
(sdl: SDL's offscreen video and dummy audio, inside the --docker image if given)
(os4 runs are always unattended: no window; --screenshot uses the QEMU monitor's
screendump, --serial collects the kernel debug lines such as Trace; --input goes through the
QEMU monitor, see below)

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Headless time limit (default 120; AROS needs ~20 s to boot)

options.name: --kickstart
options.description: (or set ESHARP_KICKSTART)

options.name: --model
options.description: Amiga model for FS-UAE: A1200 (default), A500, A500+, A600 (below the minimum spec)

options.name: --fsuae
options.description: FS-UAE executable (or set ESHARP_FSUAE)

options.name: --serial
options.description: Headless only: write the program's serial output (Trace) to this file, and print it after the run

options.name: --args
options.description: Arguments for the program (Args.Count, Args.Get, Args.Value): "SEED 42 AUTO" (m68k and sdl)

options.name: --input
options.description:
Headless only: after SHOT send mouse/keyboard input to the emulator (before the screenshot):
"click X,Y;key 9;key 50+38" with display pixels and X11 key codes, + holds keys (needs libXtst)
os4: the QEMU monitor sends it: click X,Y moves the pointer to X,Y of the screen (from the top-left
corner), rel DX,DY moves it, and key N takes an AMIGA RAW key code (Esc is 69, 96+32 is Shift+A)
sdl: the same script is replayed by the program itself after SHOT, with X,Y in the program's
screen pixels; the screenshot is the program's own frame (both also work without --headless)
Test options (esharp test; a program prints "ok NAME" / "FAIL NAME" lines):
Always runs on the host (dotnet, HOST defined). With --target m68k it also builds for m68k and runs headless in
FS-UAE (--docker, --kickstart, --model, --fsuae, --timeout as for run), then reports checks that differ.
With --target os4 it builds for os4 and boots the AmigaOS 4.1 VM in ESHARP_OS4_VM (QEMU pegasos2, on a throwaway
overlay, unattended; tools/os4vm/README.md) and compares the same way; --timeout covers the boot (about 10 s).
With --target sdl it builds for sdl and runs it headless (in the --docker image if given) and compares the same way.
Exit code is non-zero on any FAIL, crash, build error or host/Amiga difference.
Targets:
m68k      AmigaOS 3.1+ on 68020+ (amiga-gcc)
os4       AmigaOS 4 on PowerPC
morphos   MorphOS on PowerPC
aros      AROS on x86-64 (64-bit pointers)
sdl       Desktop through SDL 3 (Linux x86-64 in the esharp-sdl image)

With --target os4 it builds for os4 and boots the AmigaOS 4.1 VM in ESHARP_OS4_VM (QEMU pegasos2, on a throwaway
overlay, unattended; tools/os4vm/README.md) and compares the same way; --timeout covers the boot (about 10 s).
With --target sdl it builds for sdl and runs it headless (in the --docker image if given) and compares the same way.
Exit code is non-zero on any FAIL, crash, build error or host/Amiga difference.
Targets:
m68k      AmigaOS 3.1+ on 68020+ (amiga-gcc)
os4       AmigaOS 4 on PowerPC
morphos   MorphOS on PowerPC
aros      AROS on x86-64 (64-bit pointers)
sdl       Desktop through SDL 3 (Linux x86-64 in the esharp-sdl image)
